title: TestMain harness and DSP primitive tests - delay, crossover reconstruction, width mono-lows invariant, unity-gain crossfade, CMakeLists registration
description:
Sole phase-B owner of CMakeLists.txt, tests/TestMain.cpp, and tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp. Register DSP sources and a console test target; prove DSP primitive invariants without running full plugin hosts.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/* produced by b.1–b.4 (public APIs: DelayLineFrac, PitchShifter, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor)
- CMakeLists.txt from phase A (juce_add_plugin ShredWidth, SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER, source lists)
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.2–4.5, 4.7 and test intent in §13 if present
- Sibling plugin test harnesses under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if useful for JUCE console app + Catch2/minimal assert style

Implement:
1. tests/TestMain.cpp — minimal test runner main (Catch2 if already available via JUCE/sibling pattern; otherwise a tiny assert harness that returns non-zero on failure). Prefer self-contained asserts if Catch2 is not already wired — do not add network FetchContent if avoidable; mirror phase-A vegan CMake style.
2. tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp — focused checks:
   a. DelayLineFrac: after prepare@48k, setDelayMs known integer-ish delay, impulse-in produces peak near expected sample index (tolerance for Lagrange).
   b. PitchShifter: at deltaC=0, Hann weights / dual-head path maintains ~unity gain on a steady sine or DC-free tone (mean power ratio ~1 within tolerance); document that w_A+w_B==1 is enforced. Prefer a unit-level check of crossfade weights or gain on coherent input.
   c. MonoSafetyCrossover: with HP input == LP input (same x), reconstructed lp + hp (± inverted polarity as designed) is approximately flat (no deep notch at fc) for a swept or multi-tone stimulus; cutoff dirty flag path callable.
   d. WidthProcessor mono-lows invariant: feed identical L and R (pure mid / shared-LP-like) across width in {0,1,2}; S path leaves L'==R' and centered. Also width=1 identity on a case with L!=R.
3. CMakeLists.txt (only this task edits it in phase B):
   - Add Source/DSP/*.cpp to the ShredWidth plugin target sources.
   - Ensure SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER compile definition default 2 remains available to DSP headers.
   - Add ShredWidthTests (or similarly named) console executable linking required JUCE modules + DSP sources needed for tests; add_test so ctest can run it later in phase e.
   - Do not remove VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone or unpin JUCE.

Do not implement ShredWidthEngine or edit PluginProcessor/PluginEditor beyond what CMake source lists already reference.
acceptance_criteria: tests/TestMain.cpp exists and provides a test runner entry point

tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp exists and covers DelayLineFrac delay placement, PitchShifter unity-gain/crossfade behavior at 0 cents, MonoSafetyCrossover reconstruction without deep null when LP/HP inputs match, and WidthProcessor mono-lows / width=1 identity invariants
CMakeLists.txt registers Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.cpp, PitchShifter.cpp, MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp, WidthProcessor.cpp on the plugin target
CMakeLists.txt defines a test executable and add_test entry for the DSP primitive tests
SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER remains defined for targets that compile MonoSafetyCrossover
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/** implementation files (consume as written by b.1–b.4)
remove plugin formats or change JUCE pin
add FetchContent network dependencies if a local/minimal harness suffices

allowed: minimal assert harness or Catch2 if already available in tree
link only JUCE modules required for dsp/IIR headers
forbidden: rewrite DSP primitive algorithms in tests
